author: Khan Academy
description:
To wrap up Teacher Appreciation Week, we’re celebrating the words that make teaching unforgettable 💙

These teacherisms came from educators in our online community and classrooms across our partner schools—and we loved every single one.

Thank you for everything you give to your students—your time, your energy, and the moments that stay with them long after the classroom.
title: "Teacherisms" Teacher Appreciation Week 2026
